mapper.insert: INSERT INTO token_usage(user_id, tenant_id, model_id, model_name, skill_id, skill_name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, session_id, created_at, invocation_id, quota_date, accounting_status) VALUES(#{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{modelId}, #{modelName}, #{skillId}, #{skillName}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{sessionId}, #{createdAt}, #{invocationId}, #{quotaDate}, #{accountingStatus}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE prompt_tokens = VALUES(prompt_tokens), completion_tokens = VALUES(completion_tokens), total_tokens = VALUES(total_tokens), accounting_status = VALUES(accounting_status)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT * FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageable.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageable.offset}
SELECT SUM(t.total_tokens) FROM token_usage t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT SUM(t.total_tokens) FROM token_usage t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT t.model_name AS label, SUM(t.total_tokens) AS total_value FROM token_usage t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY t.model_name
SELECT t.skill_name AS label, SUM(t.total_tokens) AS total_value FROM token_usage t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY t.skill_name
